subject: general
question: During the 11th National Conference on Women, held in May 2025, which of the following state's police showcased ‘Mission Shakti’ as a model initiative for women’s safety?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **11th National Conference on Women**, organized in **May 2025**, highlighted groundbreaking strategies for gender-based security, where **Uttar Pradesh** emerged as a leader with its flagship **Mission Shakti** initiative.
 
• The **Uttar Pradesh Police** showcased **Mission Shakti** as a successful model initiative, emphasizing its three core pillars: **Suraksha** (Safety), **Samman** (Dignity), and **Swavalamban** (Self-reliance).
 
• The presentation at the conference detailed how the mission has transitioned from a periodic campaign to a **permanent institutional framework** within the state's policing and administrative structure.
 
• Key highlights of the presentation included the successful deployment of **Beat Power** (women police beats) and the establishment of dedicated **Women Help Desks** in all **1,584 police stations** of the state.
 
• The initiative was lauded for its ability to reduce **response times** for women-related emergencies and for creating a **Safe City** environment through technological integration. ***Hence, the correct answer is Uttar Pradesh.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Origin and Launch of Mission Shakti:**
 
 
• The mission was originally launched by Chief Minister **Yogi Adityanath** in **October 2020** during the **Shardiya Navratri** festival to curb crimes against women and children.
 
• Since its inception, it has undergone multiple phases (Phase 1 to Phase 5), with each phase expanding its scope to include **rural outreach** and **economic empowerment**.
 
 
 
• **Institutional Framework:**
 
 
• **Pink Booths**: Specialized booths have been set up in crowded market areas and outside educational institutions to provide a safe space for women to report issues.
 
• **Pink Patrols**: Specialized police units equipped with two-wheelers and four-wheelers dedicated to **24/7 patrolling** in sensitive areas to prevent harassment.
 
• **1090 Women Power Line**: A digital platform and toll-free number that allows women to complain about harassment without having to visit a police station.
 
 
 
• **Safe City Project Integration:**
 
 
• Under the **Safe City Project**, the **Uttar Pradesh** government has installed thousands of **CCTV cameras** integrated with **AI-based facial recognition** and **analytics** to monitor public spaces.
 
• It also involves the implementation of "smart" street lighting and the "Safety App" for real-time tracking during emergencies.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Multi-Departmental Coordination:** **Mission Shakti** is not limited to the police; it involves the **Department of Women and Child Development**, **Education**, and **Social Welfare** to promote legal awareness and vocational training.
 
• **Legal Awareness:** A significant portion of the mission involves **Shakti Pathshala** (Shakti Schools), where women are educated about their **legal rights**, **cyber safety**, and self-defense techniques.
 
• **Impact Metrics:** As of **2024-25**, the mission has reached millions of women through grassroots level meetings (**Gram Panchayats**), significantly increasing the reporting of domestic and public crimes, which indicates a rise in **public trust**.
